transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the release package review for 'After the Flood' ahead of the Meridian International Film Festival. I'll need each of you — rights, music, publicity, and accessibility — to walk me through your review of the current draft release sheet before I lock it. I have the draft in front of me: worldwide access, the cue 'Low Tide,' the working title 'River After Rain,' and optional accessibility materials. Who'd like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue before we go further. I confirmed with the archive this week that the license for our archival interview permits festival screening and password-protected press access only in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland. It forbids public online access and access in all other territories. The archive's signed email arrived after the last package revision, so I haven't been able to copy the confirmation into the release sheet yet. The current draft lists worldwide access, which directly conflicts with these territorial restrictions.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a music clearance issue with the cue listed on the draft release sheet. I confirmed with the publisher that the current cue 'Low Tide' is only cleared for 30 seconds, but our trailer segment runs 46 seconds. The alternate cue 'Northbound' is cleared for the full 46-second segment. I haven't replaced the cue name in the package yet because the editor delivered the latest cut after my clearance check, so the sheet still lists 'Low Tide.' We need to update it to 'Northbound' before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a publicity issue to flag. The filmmaker's signed publicity approval just arrived during the poster revision, and it requires the title 'After the Flood' and the credit line 'A film by Nia Okafor.' The current draft still lists the working title 'River After Rain' and a generic credit because the signed approval hadn't been incorporated yet. We need to update both the title and credit line before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have an accessibility issue to flag. I confirmed with the festival's access coordinator that the final submission must include open English captions and a separate audio-description track. The coordinator will reject a package containing either deliverable as optional. The festival issued this requirement in a separate accessibility email, so I haven't updated the release checklist yet — but the current draft lists accessibility materials as optional, which conflicts with the festival's ingest requirement. We need to make both open English captions and the separate audio-description track mandatory before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Replace worldwide access with US, Canada, UK, Ireland only; copy the archive's signed email confirmation into the release sheet before lock.
Replace cue 'Low Tide' with 'Northbound' and record full 46-second clearance in the release sheet before lock.
Update title to 'After the Flood' and credit line to 'A film by Nia Okafor' per the filmmaker's signed publicity approval before lock.
Mark open English captions and separate audio-description track as mandatory deliverables in the release checklist before lock.
